entities.summary: The Mosque-Madrasa of al-Ahmadiyya, commonly known as the al-Ahmadiyya Mosque or as the al-Maidan Mosque, is a Sunni mosque and madrasa, located in the al-Rusafa district of Baghdad, in the Baghdad Governorate of Iraq. The mosque is situated on al-Rashid Street in the southern part of al-Rusafa, and the east of al-Maidan Square, near al-Muradiyya Mosque.
